editorial: Last of the Three Fasts is the final Monday of BeHaB, not the third penitential day.

Hebrew prints the petition-repeat cue after Haazinah on printed172; English has no corresponding cue. Preserve that asymmetry with an empty paired expansion rather than supplying an unprinted English repeat.

Printed173/174 Ezkerah is a reprint variant under the earlier poem common identity. It has five shared units and only one concluding complete-opening choice in each language; there is no refrain repetition instruction.

The Hebrew maqqef after כי לא at the bottom of printed173 joins נשלבות at the top of174 within the continuing verse; the authoring reading suppresses an editorial space across the retained page break.
Opening and conclusion repeat the verified Monday ranges; retain unsupplied weekday Amidah/usual-service/Torah performance instructions.
